source.chapter_context: Shared-book White Scars profile. Chapter roster restrictions and Chapter-specific effects are outside this local datasheet scope.

fixed_data_comparison.scope: Bounded fixed-data comparison of source identity, numeric profile, keywords, default loadout, composition, base and cost. The profile has no fixed-data differences; the comparator does not certify full rules behavior or playability.

local_scope_validation.command: python tools/verify.py --godot .tools/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe --profile targeted --only test_suboden_khan --only test_space_marine_leader_links --only test_marine_conditional_weapon_traits --only test_attack_sequence --only test_weapon_selection --timeout 300

scope: Exact one-model profile: 105 points, source characteristics and keywords, 90 x 52 mm oval base, and no equipment-option rows.
All four fixed weapons route through Equipment and AttackPlan with source profiles: Heavy Bolt Pistol, Onslaught Gatling Cannon, Stormtooth and Power Sword.
Current Space Marines catalogs materialize for both players; unique-copy admission accepts one Suboden and rejects a duplicate.
The only source-listed Leader target is Outrider Squad; listed target admission and an unlisted Vehicle rejection are covered by the shared relation regression.
Combat Doctrines and Transhuman Strategist, including owner/Warlord checks and once-per-round CP timing.
Spear of Chogoris: Assault on ranged attacks, charge eligibility after Advance, and +1 Advance/+1 Charge only while Assault Doctrine is active.
Skilled Riders: Mobile is shared with the attached unit.
Power Sword Sustained Hits 1 applies only against non-MONSTER/non-VEHICLE targets; Extra Attacks is preserved.
Stormtooth Anti-MONSTER 4+ and Anti-VEHICLE 4+ produce target-keyword critical wounds; Lance adds 1 to Wound after the attacking unit made a Charge move.
limits: The fixed-data comparator reports no Suboden profile differences, but its global full_match_certified field is false because the parent export has unrelated structural errors.
The focused verification is local only and records legacy_starter_staged=true; do not treat it as clean-checkout demo evidence.
No network or LAN behavior was tested; network validation remains deferred to final integration.
This closes only Suboden's common-book local datasheet scope. White Scars roster legality, Chapter-specific effects, cross-sheet list legality and full army legality are not certified.
